mentions.name: Cross-platform PostgreSQL DBA tool
mentions.description: A modern cross-platform PostgreSQL DBA tool and network service, including all the features the author wishes other tools had and hyper-focused on good developer/admin experience and UX, with plans to extend it with features for small-medium teams.
mentions.problem: Existing PostgreSQL tools lack the features the author wishes they had.
mentions.source_excerpt: Building a modern cross platform PostgreSQL DBA tool (and network service), with all the features I wish other tools had, with the hopes to extend it with features for small-medium teams - hyper focused on good DX/UX.

evidence.value: Building a modern cross platform PostgreSQL DBA tool (and network service), with all the features I wish other tools had, with the hopes to extend it with features for small-medium teams - hyper focused on good DX/UX.
